limitations: Exact CIK is a source association, not security identity, a merged company, economic event or causal/timing join. Names are source-reported search labels, not preferred/current names.

Prepared submission counts and filing-date bounds retain each batch and source. Do not sum them into unique histories or comparable fiscal results.

No selected insider/disclosure/scanner record means only none in that fixed selected projection, not no activity. Prepared index absence is not missing all SEC filings. Outside-directory CIK coverage is unassessed.

P/S filings are open-market OR private reported rows; amendments are unreconciled. Plan flags are submission-level; unchecked/missing does not establish an unplanned transaction. No intent, compliance, prices, quantities or owner identities are inferred.
Disclosure concepts are not confirmed deals; scanner source-reviewed status is narrow documentary review, not independent accounting truth or training/price qualification.
Source-specific filing/report/transaction/observation clocks remain distinct. No first-public, present availability or historical security mapping is established.
Existing source objects, source-specific unknowns and separate registrant roles are preserved unchanged. No provider call, model, new collection or trading occurs.
Historical filing evidence selected by exact standard concepts, not confirmed deals, new announcements or investment signals.
Names and forms are as filed. CIK identifies the reporting issuer, not a target or security. No current identity, listing or ticker inference.
Filing dates are dates only, not earliest public, announcement, transaction or effective times. Text may discuss prior periods or accounting updates.
Concept counts include repeated contexts and dimensions. Multiple concepts may describe the same activity; no deduplication into events.
Links use standard SEC archive paths constructed from source CIK/accession. Availability was not fetched or independently verified; use SEC issuer search if unavailable.
No narratives, amounts, counterparties, owner details, source addresses or inferred deal fields are included. Names must be rendered as inert text.
The narrow concept/version selection is not complete M&A coverage; absence does not mean no acquisition or disposal.
Review original filings and announcements before interpreting. Price/outcome, materiality, novelty and historical availability are unqualified.
P and S mean open-market OR private purchases/sales as reported; these are filing review records, not verified market executions, recommendations or bullish/bearish signals.
Counts are source nonderivative transaction rows and filings, not unique economic trades, people, positions or dollars. Derivatives and other codes are outside scope.
Amendments remain separate and unreconciled. Code/direction conflicts and footnotes require original-filing review; no correction, intent, compliance or plan applicability is inferred.
Dates are as-filed date-only values, not authenticated first-public or decision-time clocks. Download/retrieval clocks are unknown; generation time is an audit clock only.
Names and ticker text are as reported by each submission, not preferred current identities. Render all strings as inert text.
Source links identify the retained SEC prepared archive. Individual original filing links are not verified; use accession to locate and review the original before drawing a conclusion.
No owner names, addresses, quantities, prices, transaction values or footnote narratives are published. No training, execution or price-outcome qualification is granted.
Coverage is the two retained filing batches, not complete company histories. Quarantine is whole-filing; unassessable data is never labeled no activity.
Issuer-level diagnostic counts sum rows across filings. Flags overlap; amendments are not reconciled and row counts are not economic trades.
Transaction bundle hashes bind sorted rowid/hash/key references, not original byte slices. Source archive and database hashes bind retained bytes.
